svg.text: Cost-aware sequential decision policy for failed recurring auto-debits on Indian e-mandates
RBI / NPCI CONSTRAINTS — ENFORCED, NOT LEARNED
Constraints are checked before a presentment is committed. Violations are counted and reported, never silently dropped.
GENERATOR — SYNTHETIC BOOK, KNOWS GROUND TRUTH
a failed mandate + an ISO return code,
and nothing else the agent may read.
POLICY / AGENT — SEES ONLY WHAT A REAL PSP WOULD SEE
payday posterior over the balance process → candidate dates
cross-customer bank-health signal, pooled across the book
never retry — escalate to re-collection of instrument
never retry — further presentment is non-compliant
re-authentication path, not a balance problem
masking posterior over the true underlying cause
one shared scorer — every handler proposes, this decides
the term a fixed retry schedule cannot see
Every decision emits a rupee-denominated reason — the audit trail.
24h notice lead time · 00:00–07:00 window · attempt N of 4
A candidate that fails any check is never scored, not merely down-weighted.
INFORMATION BARRIER — the oracle sees future balances, the agent never does
EVALUATION — OFFLINE ONLY, NEVER VISIBLE TO THE AGENT
replays a policy over the book
The oracle is computed from ground truth the policy never receives. It bounds what was achievable; it informs no decision.
Data is synthetic by design — only a generated book yields the counterfactual every retry date not taken would have produced. Cost parameters are declared estimates.
